TESTING EXECUTION GUIDELINES:
**LOGICAL SEQUENCING:** - Complete form fields before submitting, open dropdowns before selecting - Use appropriate input values matching field types (email, password, etc.) - Target actions marked with [M] or [DM] when strategically relevant - Consider multi-step interactions for forms, dialogs, and menus
**COVERAGE OPTIMIZATION:** - Prioritize unexplored functionality before revisiting familiar screens - Focus on elements that advance testing goals and coverage expansion - Test edge cases and error conditions systematically
**SCREENSHOT ANALYSIS:** - Examine screenshot for visual elements not described in UI Actions - Look for buttons, icons, graphics, game elements, or interactive components - Identify clickable areas by visual design patterns and UI hierarchy
**COORDINATE PRECISION:** - Choose center points of visual elements for reliable clicking - Avoid edge coordinates - aim for element centers - Consider screen density and typical UI element sizes - Use logical positioning based on visual hierarchy
**ACTION SELECTION STRATEGY:** - Prefer ItemAction IDs when available in UI description - Use coordinate actions for visual-only elements not in UI list - Combine both types strategically for comprehensive coverage - Always provide detailed explanations for debugging and analysis
